faq.priceAnswer: The base price per night is {prices}. The platform adds its service fee and the tourist tax: the exact total for your dates is shown on Airbnb and Booking.com.

faq.feesAnswer: On top of the base price, allow for: {fees}. The platform also adds its service fee and the tourist tax, and shows the total to pay before you book.

faq.seasonQuestion: Does the price change with the season?
faq.weekQuestion: How much is a week at the cottage?
faq.weekAnswer: The site gives the base price per night, from {price}. For a week, Airbnb and Booking.com work out the total for your dates, service fee and tourist tax included, with a weekly discount when one applies.
faq.feesAnswerNone: Yes: the platform adds its service fee and the tourist tax to the base price. The total to pay is shown on Airbnb and Booking.com before you book.
